scripts.build: npm run build -w @swarm/shared && npm run build -w @swarm/server && npm run build -w @swarm/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @swarm/shared && npm run dev -w @swarm/server
scripts.lint: eslint apps/server/src apps/server/test packages/shared/src apps/web/src tools --max-warnings 0
scripts.test: npm run build -w @swarm/shared && npm run test -w @swarm/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @swarm/shared && npm run typecheck -w @swarm/server && npm run typecheck -w @swarm/web
